translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: MATEO
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni MATEO

content: Id Suhu ni Juan no Tohodboutismu iddos mgo Tinodduwan Din nod undiyon to ki Disas
Nopongnga id nonaw ni Disas iddos langun tadda riyot sopuu-oruwon tinodduwan din, id ipanow sikandin woy id undiyon to mgo bonuwa no morani rutun amoy'd nonaw woy od ponudtuu to kahit Monama.
Na si Juan no Tohodboutismu, diyon poron sikandin to prisuwan. To norinog din iddos id puungan ni Disas Krays, id po-undiyon din kos mgo tinodduwan din.
To kod-inguma ran dutun, id inturan dan si Disas, kahi ran to, “Sikkow ron be-en iddos id oongatan doy o od angat koy pa to ossa?”
Mid tavak si Disas to, “Livod kow riyot ki Juan woy ponudtuli row sikandin to langun no nokita woy norinog dow.

Oyya su iddos mgo butud nokokita ron, dos mgo pungku od poko-ipanow ron, dos duwon bohok no et-et no-uliyan don, dos diid dinog od pokorinog don, dos id poomatoy nongovadnow, woy noponudtulan don mandad to Moppiyon Dinoggan iddos mgo worowora.
Ponudtuu row mandad kandin no moppiya kod kotomanan taddot minuvu no waa kodduworuwa koddi.”
Dos Osengan ni Disas Moka-atag ki Juan no Tohodboutismu

Na, to id ipanow ron iddos mgo minuvu nid suhu ni Juan, mid ikahi si Disas moka-atag ki Juan diyot mo-uraan minuvu, kahi rin to, “To kod-undiyon dow to ki Juan to riyon pa sikandin to noka-awoy-awoy'n lugaa, ondan man kos id imman dow nod kokita? Idda vo so minuvu no od kopalinpalin kos poomdom iling to aggi nod kopiyodpiyod to kaamag?
Ondan man kos id kopi-i row nod kokita rutun? Idda vo so minuvu no id oumpak to mahaa? Konna en, su iddos od oumpak to ungketen, diyon da id oubpa to polasyu.
Ondan kos id kopi-i row nod kokita rutun? Idda vo so propeta? Oyya en, woy od ikohiyan ku sikiyu, no iddos nokita row, lampas pa sikandin to dumon mgo propeta.
Oyyos sikandin en iddos no-ikahi riyot Nosulat no Kahit Monama no mid ungketen to,

content.text: ‘Id popiyod ku iddos koddin tohodponudtuu no od unna kikow amoy'd panoy to kod-inguma ru.’

content: Na ponayun mid ikahi si Disas to, “Bonnaavonnaa nod ikohiyon ku koniyu, no waa poron minuvu nid tobbow ka-ay to ampow't ingod no lampas pa ki Juan no Tohodboutismu. Piru iddos minuvu no moobbava to langun no no-iraom to kodharit Monama, lampas pa sikandin ki Juan.
“Pomon poron to timpu to kodtigkanoy ni Juan no Tohodboutismu taman ko-ungkay, id udsuu pe-en iddos kodso-ob to kodharit Monama, woy duwon mandad od pomohos nod kolonug sikandan diyon to kodhari rin.
Iddos langun no propeta woy dos diyot mgo Suhu ni Moises, id posaddoo en taddot id poponudtuu to Monama kandan moka-atag to kodhari rin, taman to mid inguma si Juan amoy'd tuman taddon ponudtulon.
Woy otid tonggapon dow iddos id ponudtuu ran, od koovottan dow no ini si Juan, sikandin en si Elias no od livod.
Na sikiyu, su duwon man tolinga row, pa-ayyad kow pominog.”

Na ponayun mid ikahi si Disas to, “Ondan man kos od koponunggelengan ku to mgo minuvu to inin timpu? Noko-iling sikandan to mgo anak nod ponggaaw riyot plasa. Od po-ikohiyoy ran diyot mgo duma ran to,
‘Id totogunggu koy atag koniyu, piru waa kow man id sayow. Id pondaawit koy, piru waa kow man id sinoggow.’

Dos mgo minuvu to inin timpu, od poko-iling en mandad taddon mgo anak, oyyos iddot kod-undini ni Juan no Tohodboutismu, no inaayun id puasa woy waa id inom tod pokohubug, od ikohiyon dan moho no id losuran sikandin to busow.

Woy siyak no Anak to Minuvu, diyot kod-undini ku, nokita ran no mid ka-an woy id inom a. De-en od ikohiyon dan moho no sopeton a woy polohubug, woy oukuy a kun to mgo tohodsukut to buhis woy dumon mosaasaa. Piru ahad ungketen kos id ikahi ran, ukit taddot pinuungan to Monama, od koposivonnalan no moraom kos koovottan din.”
Dos mgo Bonuwa no Waa id Sondit woy'd Tanan to mgo Saa Ran
Nopongnga tadda, id sawoy ni Disas iddos id pon-oubpa riyot mgo bonuwa nid puungan din to mo-uraan mokososoobbu, oyyos waa ran id sondit woy'd tanan to mgo saa ran.

Kahi rin to, “Moka-arat-arat kod kotomanan dow no mgo toho Corazin woy sikiyu mandad no toho Betsaida! Su mo-uraa kos id puungan ku no mokososoobbu ruwot koniyu, piru waa kow en id sondit woy'd tanan to mgo saa row. Otik diyon ku pa idda puungi to Tiro woy Sidon, nouhoy ran don nanoy id oumpak to saku woy mid ounsad diyot ibmukon, patow to kodsondit to mgo saa ran.
De-en od ikohiyan ku sikiyu, no riyot allow to kodhukum, otik movoggat man kos silut taddot mgo toho Tiro woy Sidon, iyon kow pobbo no toho Corazin woy toho Betsaida.

Woy sikiyu mandad no toho Capernaum, kunan dow ayu kod inguma kow taman to langit. Piru id subbuk kow ra vos en baling diyon to linow't apuy. Otik diyon ku pa puungi to Sodoma iddos mgo mokososoobbu nid puungan ku riyot koniyu, tadda poron nanoy kos Sodoma taman ko-ungkay.
De-en od ikohiyan ku sikiyu, no riyot allow to kodhukum, otik movoggat man kos silut atag taddot mgo toho Sodoma, iyon kow pobbo no toho Capernaum.”
Duwon Ko-imooyyan diyot ki Disas

Na iddon timpu, id dasaa si Disas, kahi rin to, “Amoy ku, sikkow en kos Monama no komunoy to langit woy livuta. Od doongon ku sikkow, su iddos kovonnaan no waa ru id posaddoo riyot mgo minuvu nod ikahi no mopandoy woy moraom kos koovottan, diyon du id posaddoo to mgo minuvu no movavow kos koovottan iling to mgo anak.
Oyya en, Amoy ku, od doongon ku sikkow su ini me-en kos kikow'n id kopi-i.”

Nopongnga idda, mid ikahi si Disas diyot mgo minuvu to, “Id sanna koddi to Amoy ku iddos langun. Oyyos waa osson nokokilaa koddi, idda ra en so Amoy ku, su anak a man nikandin. Woy waa mandad osson nokokilaa to Amoy ku, siyak da en woy dos mgo minuvu no id kopi-i ku nod pokokilaa kandin.
“Porani kow koddi, sikiyu langun no novoggatan woy novolloy su od po-imaayyon ku sikiyu.
Dumoruma kow to koddin mgo suhu
woy pohinonaw kow koddi amoy duwon ko-imooyyan dow, su mosunay a woy mopoobbava.
Oyya su iddos koddin mgo suhu, moomok da nod tumanon woy mahan nod puungan.”

footnotes.text: Otik diyot Griego no kinohiyan, id takos dow kos yugu ku.Dos kohulugan tadda, idda en so kodtanggap to nonaw ni Disas woy dos koddumoruma to suhu rin.
